prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 3 winning tests (+9.0%, +4.3%, and +4.8% after noise correction), though no clear effect was seen in 3 other tests.
Adding a new screen to adoption was harmful, as both tests agreed on a negative impact after noise correction (-2.5% and -10.4%).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign and finish new_screen changes because their tests disagreed after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for home new_flow and choose_path reorder changes because each has only 1 test.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, particularly for tests that failed or were stopped early.
Predictions were too low for the round 2 finish new_screen test (+8.0% predicted vs +9.8% noise-corrected) and round 8 sign_in reorder test (+0.8% predicted vs +9.0% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -5.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -10.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.5% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Relocation After Pick Friend Stage: Relocate the sign-in step to immediately follow the pick_friend screen prior to media upload. (why: Reordering sign_in steps has historical success (+9.0% after noise correction), and securing user authentication right after pet selection reduces drop-off prior to heavy photo processing.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Quick Companion Controls Summary Screen: Insert a new summary screen following home_intro that highlights essential desktop pet interaction controls. (why: Support logs reveal user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding, and previous finish new_screen tests showed a +9.8% lift.)
2: [home, redesign] Split View Generation Waiting Hub: Redesign the waiting screen layout into a split view with live status visuals and progress indicators. (why: The waiting step has a high median duration of 201s and a mean of 2336s; a split layout keeps users engaged while pet rendering finishes.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion System Tray Verification Flow: Add a tray verification component to home_intro confirming the pet icon is visible in the desktop system tray. (why: Support received multiple tickets where pets did not show up on desktop or the desktop process stalled silently.)
4: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Selection Flexibility Reassurance: Add a prominent reassurance hint on pick_friend stating companion traits and appearance can be changed later. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion at 60.9% and 89s median duration due to selection hesitation.)
5: [home, notification] Background Generation Readiness Notification Switch: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: The waiting stage has a long tail (mean 2336s), leading to drop-offs when users navigate away while waiting.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Initial Onboarding Duration Reassurance: Display a time estimate badge and progress indicator on the initial story introduction screen. (why: Setting clear onboarding expectations upfront reduces early bounce rates and tail latency (choose_path mean 514s).)
7: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Launch Guidance Copy: Update home_intro headline and body to provide explicit guidance on locating the pet on the desktop screen. (why: Support logs indicate users frequently lose track of where their companion spawns on the desktop after onboarding.)
8: [adoption, layout] Centered Adoption Certificate Layout: Switch adoption_certificate screen layout to centered with a clear step counter display. (why: Simplifying the layout of adoption_certificate removes clutter during the lowest-converting onboarding phase (60.9%).)
